maria (product): Trying to pull together a prereq matrix for private deploys (VPC + on‑prem) so we can clearly map customer asks -> shipping scope. Want to capture hard blockers vs nice‑to‑haves.

ajay (eng): Happy to help. We should separate network primitives (IP ranges, NAT, proxies) from packaging (offline installer, agent). The big constraints are kernel modules for older onprem hw and cert rotation flow.

liz (sre): +1. Also need to call out observability hooks required for SLA: heartbeat, metrics endpoint, and trace-forwarding. Those are non-negotiable for Dedicated parity.

sam (solutions): From field: four customers asked specifically for KMS integration (Cloud KMS + HSM fallback), explicit egress allowlist docs, and an offline upgrade path with <15m downtime. Two asked for a rollback playbook.

maria (product): Cool. Proposal: create a 2x2 matrix (blocking vs optional) x (networking vs packaging). I'll sketch initial rows and we can iterate. Quick ask: can someone confirm which of the KMS asks are feasible in the MVP? @ajay @liz

ajay (eng): Feasible: Cloud KMS integration (AES keys via API) in MVP. HSM direct attach is bigger (driver + cert flow) — label that "post‑MVP". Offline upgrade with <15m needs us to ship an atomic swap mechanism for model artifacts; doable but will add ~2 sprints.

liz (sre): Rollback playbook is operationally required if we commit to customer uptime SLAs. Recommend we make rollback docs mandatory for launch customers. Also heartbeat + minimal metrics must be in the agent by GA.

sam (solutions): Noted. Customers also expect deterministic IP handoff during upgrades for firewall rules. Is that in scope?

ajay (eng): Deterministic IP for in‑place upgrades is hard on shared infra. For onprem we can support interface stickiness via config, but cloud VPC will need support from infra (elastic ENI or stable NAT). Mark as "engineering dependency" and tag infra.

maria (product): OK. I'm going to propose launch gates: 1) Packaging: offline installer + agent + upgrade/rollback docs, 2) Networking: egress allowlist guide + sample terraform for VPC, 3) Security: KMS integration (cloud) + audit logs, 4) Observability: heartbeat + metrics + sample dashboards. All must be implemented for the GA customers list.

ajay (eng): Timeline rough sketch: MVP (limited GA customers) in 6 weeks if we scope HSM and H/A out. GA (wider) in 12 weeks with HSM/ENI improvements. Need two engs on packaging, one on networking, one on security/OAuth.

liz (sre): SLA tradeoffs we should call out: 
- committed P99 latency SLOs only for Dedicated/GW routes, not for onprem connectivity-dependent setups
- rolling upgrades allowed only if heartbeat retention >= 48h

sam (solutions): I'll consolidate customer asks into the matrix and tag with priority (P0–P2). Also will push customers to take part in the limited GA to validate upgrade playbook.

maria (product): Nice. Next steps: @sam make the customer‑priority column in the matrix and add which customers are blocking. @ajay create an engineering feasibility column (with estimated sprints). @liz add operational launch gates. I'll schedule 30m on Mon to review.

deploy-bot: Reminder: private-deploy-installer v0.9 candidate published to `staging` at 1755560000.

maria (product): Thanks — I'll link the staging build in the doc. Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/private-prereq-matrix (please drop quick notes). :white_check_mark: 

ajay (eng): Quick note on checklist (for the doc):
```
- Packaging: offline installer (yes)
- Agent: heartbeat + metrics (yes)
- KMS: cloud KMS (yes), HSM (post-MVP)
- Networking: egress allowlist guide (yes), ENI stickiness (infra dep)
- Upgrade: atomic artifact swap (requires testing), rollback playbook (mandatory)
```

liz (sre): I'll add the production runbook snippet and failure modes.

sam (solutions): Adding customer mapping now.

maria (product): Great work team. We'll iterate on the matrix and bring to PM/Eng sync. If anyone has a red blocker, ping me directly.
